title: Twentieth-Century Genocides in Eastern Europe
description: Examines the common and unique features of genocides, ethnic cleansings and forced population transfers in twentieth-century Eastern Europe including the Ukrainian Famine, the Holocaust and the Bosnian War.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of SLST 482, HSTR 451 (if taken in the same topic), HSTR 451A, HSTR 519 (if taken in the same topic), SLST 410 (if taken in the same topic), SLST 581.
No knowledge of any Slavic languages required.
May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
